Nowak-Węgrzyn et al. (2019) conducted a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial to evaluate whether vital wheat gluten (VWG) oral immunotherapy (OIT) is effective at increasing wheat tolerance in children and young adults with wheat allergy.

In today's AE, you will analyze a dataset *simulated* to represent this study using the tools from lecture.

(<https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30389226/>)

# Packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
wheat_trial <- read_csv("data/wheat.csv")
```

Variables:

| Variable             | Description                                                            |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `id`                 | Unique participant identifier                                          |
| `age`                | Participant age (years)                                                |
| `baseline_wheat_ige` | Baseline wheat IgE level (kU/L) --- a measure of allergy severity      |
| `vwg_oit`            | Treatment indicator: 1 = VWG OIT, 0 = Placebo                          |
| `max_dose_mg`        | Maximum tolerated wheat protein dose (mg) at the year-1 food challenge |
